meta.title: A bid cannot be re-activated for a vendor removed from the round

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
The buyer removes the invited vendor from the live round.
The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Please add this vendor to audience to re-open bid”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A bid cannot be re-activated for a vendor removed from the round

expected.message: Please add this vendor to audience to re-open bid
